title: kenney-asset-kit: SKILL.md 2D prose fixes (Vector/ as style reference, filtering caveat)
description: GH#6 items 2 and 3. (2) SKILL.md:188 describes Vector/ only as a resolution escape hatch; it is actually the style reference -- Kenney 2D packs are Flash exports, every path is fill=... stroke=none and the darker rim is a separate filled path underneath, not a stroke. A conforming new sprite can use an ordinary SVG stroke in the fill's darker shade and match. Say 'read it before drawing anything'. (3) SKILL.md:198 'Pixel-art packs need texture filtering set to nearest' has no counterexample -- vector packs (Tower Defense, Space Shooter) are anti-aliased and must stay on the default linear filter.
close_reason: kenney_probe2d.py shipped (probe + --check, stdlib PNG decode, segment-tolerance palette rule validated at tol=12 across 5 packs, 9 negative controls); SKILL.md 2D section rewritten with the Vector/ style reference, the linear-filter counterexample, and an 'Adding a sprite to a 2D pack' arm. CLAUDE.md, README, both manifests updated; version 0.10.0.

title: kenney-asset-kit: ship kenney_probe2d.py (probe + --check)
description: GH#6 item 1. The 2D half of kenney-asset-kit has no authoring or conformance arm: SKILL.md '## 5. Adding a model to a kit' is 3D-only and hands the gate to blender-mcp-modelling style_probe.py --check, which has no 2D equivalent. Ship scripts/kenney_probe2d.py, stdlib-only, mirroring kenney_probe.py: canvas size + uniformity, retina ratio, median/max opaque bbox, frequency-sorted palette, --json. Plus --check <candidate.png>: size, 2x retina counterpart, non-blank, centred, >=1px margin, every opaque colour on-palette. NON-OBVIOUS: 'on-palette' must mean 'within tolerance of the line SEGMENT between some pair of palette entries', not exact membership -- anti-aliased edges land between two flat fills and exact matching false-fails on Kenney's own sprites. Measured: worst legitimate blend 8.21, off-palette magenta control 188.50; tolerance 12 separates them.
close_reason: kenney_probe2d.py shipped (probe + --check, stdlib PNG decode, segment-tolerance palette rule validated at tol=12 across 5 packs, 9 negative controls); SKILL.md 2D section rewritten with the Vector/ style reference, the linear-filter counterexample, and an 'Adding a sprite to a 2D pack' arm. CLAUDE.md, README, both manifests updated; version 0.10.0.

title: godot-game-ui: palette is always the shipped amber; make the choice explicit per game vibe
description: The kit ships one warm amber PALETTE and nothing prompts a choice, so every scaffolded game comes out yellow. Add named palettes in references/palettes.md, a --palette flag on both scaffolders (parsing that file, mirroring the seed.py/axes.md convention), and SKILL.md guidance making the choice a required first step.
close_reason: Shipped in 0.8.0: six named palettes in references/palettes.md, --palette/--list-palettes on both scaffolders, SKILL.md guidance making the choice part of installing.

title: game-from-gibberish: seed.py mojibakes the em dash on Windows
description: GH#4. seed.py never pins sys.stdout encoding, so the em dash in the printed casting is written as cp1252 0x97 on a Windows console. Any UTF-8 consumer (pipe, redirect, subagent) sees a corrupted char, and SKILL.md step 3 says to copy that casting into SEED.md.
close_reason: Fixed in 8569118: pinned sys.stdout/stderr to UTF-8 with errors=replace. Verified 0x97 before, E2 80 94 after, casting content identical.

title: godot-game-ui: shell-screen button captions cannot be changed without forking the template
description: GH#3 defect 2. results_screen.gd, pause_menu.gd, title_screen.gd hardcode 'Play again'/'Main menu'/'Resume'/'Quit' etc. ResultsScreen already exports heading, so the title is configurable while the buttons are not. Export the captions with unchanged defaults.
close_reason: Fixed in 732054e: captions exported as again/menu/resume/restart/quit/play_label in both skills, defaults verbatim. Verified defaults + overrides in Godot 4.7.1.

title: godot-game-ui: backdrop colour is a literal in 4 templates, unreachable from the palette
description: GH#3 defect 1. results_screen.gd and title_screen.gd in both UI skills call UiTheme.backdrop(Color(0.06,0.05,0.07,1.0)) — an opaque near-copy of UiTheme.BACKDROP. Re-skinning the PALETTE block leaves the backdrop at the old colour, which is exactly what SKILL.md idea 1 forbids.
close_reason: Fixed in 2fc99b4: BACKDROP_OPAQUE, CHIP_INK, SLOT_EMPTY added to palette; 4 literal sites routed through them in both skills. Re-skin walk fails on all 4 pre-fix, passes post-fix; smoke+juice green.

title: File [G-007] upstream: godot-selftest-harness lint --find-orphans is opt-in
description: log.md 2026-08-15 commit pass on plant-tower-defense, harness 0.19.0. Committing WIP that added Plant.set_selected() with no caller: plain lint and the 43-test suite both passed; --find-orphans caught it immediately (WARN: res://game/plant.gd: set_selected() has no reference outside its own file). Nothing prompts the flag and /verify does not pass it, so the default gate is green on a feature that cannot run. Proposed: run the orphan pass always, print a non-gating denominator line (Orphans: 0 of 24 script(s)) alongside Shaders:/UIDs:; or gate only on a public method new in the diff with no external reference. Distinct from SeveralHerr/godot-selftest-harness#7. File via skill-feedback-issue.
close_reason: Filed as SeveralHerr/godot-selftest-harness#11. Re-verified all three source claims against the installed 0.19.0 cache (84c7087) before filing; found two internal precedents in the repo's own docs that argue for the fix.
